This requires delivery of FCD Segment Data covering all state roads in Denmark as well as municipal roads connected to the state road network and major ramp connections. The FCD is to be used primarily with several existing software systems for traffic analysis and planning purposes. Currently the The Danish Road Directorate expects the upcoming procurement will have the following deliveries: • Raw time stamped GPS/GNSS point data. • Aggregated vehicle speeds distributed over a segment road network, where speeds are based on map-matched GPS/GNSS data

Nonetheless, the space engineering (thermal) domains need to be ready to adopt thesetechnologies as they become available in order to drive efficiency and reducecosts. The expected benefits are twofold:- Reduced development time and cost (e.g. in the case of faster design surveys, faster test correlation or model exchange);- Improved quality and/or performance (e.g. in the case of optimization use case, or use of hitherto unexploited data sets).A number of potential usescases for AI are already envisaged.
